verdict.detail: Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Recorded at the Chipping Norton Recording Studio, Oxfordshire, August 1974.

Hooray for Brian Goodman.
Special Thanks to – Dave, Tina, Nat, Brian, Martin.

Shorepak by Shorewood Packaging Co. Ltd., England

℗ 1974 Transatlantic Records Limited.
Published by Heathside Music

Made in England

Sleeve has track lengths for side A swapped around. Label lists them correctly.
Pressing plant identified through characteristic 28+32mm pressing ring.
